title: Hooks around cached computation
expected: Noncacheable hooks run on a cache hit.
Changing hook-produced input invalidates the dependent action.

cases.name: pre-fails
cases.change: Use FAILURE_POINT=pre in a disposable development invocation.

cases.name: main-fails
cases.expect: Pre and main recorded, no post.

cases.name: post-fails
cases.expect: All events recorded and invocation fails.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
